g.text: Inside next(): One Atomic Update, No I/O
Everything below runs under a single in-process lock -- microseconds, never a network call.
No lock ever waits on I/O -- every branch above is pure CPU and memory. The only slow path is wait_until_next_millis,
which spins for at most a fraction of a millisecond, and only when a single machine exhausts 4,096 IDs in one ms.
